firetrucks.notes: The official firetrucks count is the guaranteed Fire engine quantity when the mission has no separate chance field for this key.

platform_trucks.notes: The official platform_trucks count represents Aerial Appliance Trucks. A same-key chance field converts the quantity to a probabilistic canonical requirement.

battalion_chief_vehicles.notes: The official battalion_chief_vehicles count represents Fire Officers. A same-key chance field converts the quantity to a probabilistic canonical requirement.

heavy_rescue_vehicles.notes: The official heavy_rescue_vehicles count represents Rescue Support Vehicles. A same-key chance field converts the quantity to a probabilistic canonical requirement.

water_tankers.notes: The official water_tankers count represents UK Water Carriers. A same-key chance field converts the quantity to a probabilistic canonical requirement.

mobile_command_vehicles.notes: The official field is displayed as ICCU or Ambulance Control Units. The quantity is a qualifying total across the two canonical resource types, not two simultaneous guaranteed vehicles.

hazmat_vehicles.notes: The official field is displayed as HazMat Units or CBRN Vehicles. A same-key chance applies to the qualifying alternative group as a whole.

mobile_air_vehicles.notes: The official mobile_air_vehicles count represents Breathing Apparatus Support Units. A same-key chance field converts the quantity to a probabilistic canonical requirement.

oneof_fire_engine_or_rescue.notes: The official field is displayed as Fire Engines or Rescue Support Vehicles. The quantity is a qualifying total across the two canonical resource types.

oneof_fire_engine_or_rescue_or_ladder.notes: The official field is displayed as Fire Engines, Rescue Support Vehicles or Aerial Appliance Trucks. The quantity is a qualifying total across the three canonical resource types.

police_cars.notes: The official police_cars quantity is a Police Car requirement. A same-key chance converts it to a probabilistic requirement.

k9.notes: The official k9 count represents Dog Support Units (DSU). A same-key chance field converts the quantity to a probabilistic canonical requirement.

hazard_response_primary.notes: The official hazard_response_primary field is displayed as PRVs. The abbreviation remains unexpanded.

hazard_response_secondary.notes: The official hazard_response_secondary field is displayed as SRVs. The abbreviation remains unexpanded.

foam.notes: The official foam count represents guaranteed Foam Units.

kdow_orgl.notes: The official kdow_orgl quantity is displayed as required Operational Team Leaders. A same-key chance field converts the quantity to probabilistic personnel.

ambulances.notes: The official ambulances count is the guaranteed number of frontline Ambulance vehicles.

oneof_police_patrol_or_swat.notes: The official field is displayed as Police Cars or Armed Response Vehicles (ARVs). The quantity is a qualifying total across the two canonical resource types.

midwife.notes: The official midwife quantity is displayed as required Community Midwives. The verified records publish no chance field, so the quantity is guaranteed.

ems_mobile_command.notes: The official field is displayed as ICCU, Ambulance Control Unit or Airfield Firefighting Command Vehicle. The quantity is a qualifying total across the three canonical command resources.

emergency_welfare.notes: The official emergency_welfare count represents Welfare Vehicles. A same-key chance converts the quantity to a probabilistic requirement where published.

mass_casualty_equipment.notes: The official mass_casualty_equipment count represents guaranteed Mass Casualty Equipment units.

police_helicopters.notes: The official police_helicopters count is the guaranteed number of Police Helicopters.

oneof_police_drone_or_helicopter.notes: The official field is displayed as Police Helicopters or Drones. The quantity is a qualifying total across the two canonical aerial-search resources.

coastal_boat.notes: The official coastal_boat count is displayed as the required Inland Rescue Boat (Trailer) quantity on the verified UK incidents.

two_way.notes: The official two_way count is displayed as the required Road Rail Unit quantity on verified UK railway incidents.

railway_police.notes: The top-level official railway_police count is displayed as the required EIU quantity. Railway Police Officer staffing remains separately represented by personnel_educations.

traffic_car.notes: The official traffic_car count represents Traffic Cars. Missions carrying need_traffic_car_only_if_present=true are delegated to the conditional resource contract; all other records use the standard guaranteed or same-key probabilistic mapping.

coastal_rescue.notes: The official coastal_rescue count is displayed as the required Coastguard Rescue Vehicle quantity.

atv_carrier.notes: The official field is displayed as required ATV Carriers.

oneof_mountain_atv_or_search_and_rescue_.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Mountain Rescue 4x4 and SAR 4x4 resources.

search_and_rescue_command.notes: The official field is displayed as Control Vans.

coastal_helicopter.notes: The official field is displayed as Coastguard Rescue Helicopters. A same-key chance converts it to a probabilistic requirement.

large_coastal_boat.notes: The official field is displayed as All-Weather Lifeboats.

min_pump_speed.notes: The value is a minimum pumping-speed capability threshold and is retained separately from vehicle quantities.

rescue_dogs.notes: The official field is displayed as Search Dog Units.

bomb_disposal_crew.notes: The retained UK source identifies Bomb Disposal Crew as a discrete required resource.

drone.notes: The official field is displayed as required Drones.

flood_equipment.notes: The official field represents Flood Rescue Units/equipment as a discrete dispatch resource.

arff.notes: The UK airfield requirement is displayed as Major Foam Tenders.

coastal_command.notes: The official field is displayed as Coastguard Commanders.

oneof_fire_engine_or_airport_fire_engine.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Fire Engines and Rapid Intervention Vehicles.

police_horse.notes: The official page labels this requirement Mounted Units.

airport_equipment.notes: The official field is displayed as Airfield Operations Vehicles.

coastal_guard_boat.notes: The official field is displayed as Inshore Lifeboats.

coastal_mud_rescue.notes: The official field is displayed as Coastguard Mud Rescue Units.

coastal_support.notes: The official coastal_support field is displayed as required Support Units on Coastguard and Coastal Rescue missions. It is distinct from the CRV/coastal_rescue requirement.

mud_rescue.notes: The official field is displayed as Mud Decontamination Units.

search_and_rescue.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across the three UK Search and Rescue operational-support resources.

airport_command.notes: The official field is displayed as required Airfield Operations Supervisors.

bomb_disposal_command.notes: The retained UK source identifies Bomb Disposal Command as a discrete required resource.

bomb_disposal_diver_crew.notes: The retained UK source identifies Bomb Disposal Diver Crew as a discrete required resource.

bomb_disposal_diver_equipment.notes: The retained UK source identifies Bomb Disposal Diver Equipment as a discrete required resource.

bomb_disposal_equipment.notes: The retained UK source identifies Bomb Disposal Equipment as a discrete required resource.

elw_airport.notes: The official field is displayed as the dedicated Airfield Firefighting Command Vehicle.

oneof_fire_command_or_airport_fire_comma.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Fire Officers and Airfield Firefighting Command Vehicles.

oneof_fire_engine_or_airport_fire_engine.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Fire Engines and Major Foam Tenders.

height_rescue_units.notes: The official field is displayed as Coastguard Rope Rescue Units.

oneof_airport_fire_engine_or_engine_larg.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Rapid Intervention Vehicles and Major Foam Tenders.

oneof_coastal_guard_boat_or_boat_large.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Inshore and All-Weather Lifeboats.

oneof_fire_ladder_or_rescue_stairs.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Aerial Appliance Trucks and Rescue Stairs.

bomb_disposal_heavy_equipment.notes: The retained UK source identifies Heavy Bomb Disposal Equipment as a discrete required resource.

oneof_fire_command_advanced_or_airport_f.notes: The advanced command alternative accepts ICCU, Ambulance Control Unit or Airfield Firefighting Command Vehicle.

oneof_paramedic_or_paramedic_advanced.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Rapid Response Vehicles and Specialist Paramedic RRVs.

water_rescue.notes: The source uses the same two-resource 4x4 alternative for this Search and Rescue requirement.

coastal_jetski.notes: The official overlay page displays Rescue Watercraft (Trailer).

oneof_fire_engine_or_airport_fire_engine.notes: The published quantity is a qualifying total across Fire Engines, Rapid Intervention Vehicles and Major Foam Tenders.

platform_trucks.notes: The percentage is the probability that the published Aerial Appliance Truck quantity is required.

battalion_chief_vehicles.notes: The percentage is the probability that the published Fire Officer quantity is required.

heavy_rescue_vehicles.notes: The percentage is the probability that the published Rescue Support Vehicle quantity is required.

water_tankers.notes: The percentage is the probability that the published Water Carrier quantity is required.

mobile_air_vehicles.notes: The percentage is the probability that the published Breathing Apparatus Support Unit quantity is required.

k9.notes: The percentage is the probability that the published Dog Support Unit quantity is required.

patient_transport.notes: The published integer percentage is owned by the patient contract and maps to patients.transport_probability.

patient_critical_care.notes: The published integer percentage is owned by the patient contract and maps to patients.critical_care_probability.

kdow_orgl.notes: The integer percentage is the probability that the published Operational Team Leader quantity is required.

hazmat_vehicles.notes: The integer percentage is the probability that the published HazMat Unit or CBRN Vehicle alternative quantity is required.

traffic_car.notes: The same-key percentage is the Traffic Car requirement probability. Conditional availability remains separately retained when the official flag is true.

emergency_welfare.notes: Same-key percentage for the Welfare Vehicle requirement.

coastal_helicopter.notes: Same-key percentage for the Coastguard Rescue Helicopter requirement.

police_cars.notes: Same-key percentage for the Police Car requirement.

fire_stations.notes: The official fire_stations value is the minimum Fire Station count used to generate the mission.

police_stations.notes: The official police_stations value is the minimum Police Station count used to generate the mission.

rescue_stations.notes: The official internal rescue_stations value is the minimum UK Ambulance Station prerequisite retained as canonical rescue_stations.

hazard_response_ems.notes: The official hazard_response_ems value is the minimum HART Base prerequisite.

fire_support_count.notes: The official fire_support_count value is the minimum Foam Extension prerequisite shown on current UK mission pages.

main_building.notes: The field is a MissionChief source/building-family discriminator rather than a count-based player prerequisite. Every value observed in the retained 24 July 2026 UK snapshot is narrowly allow-listed and preserved in generation_rules.main_building_type.

riot_police.notes: The official riot_police value is displayed as the minimum Police & Public Order Extension count required to generate the mission.

general_practitioner.notes: The official general_practitioner value is displayed as the minimum GP Surgery count required to generate the mission.

mass_casualty_count.notes: The official mass_casualty_count value is the minimum Mass Casualty Extension count required to generate the mission.

police_helicopter_stations.notes: The official police_helicopter_stations value is the minimum Police Helicopter Station count used to generate the mission.

wasserrettung.notes: The official wasserrettung prerequisite is displayed as the required Technical Rescue Extension count on the verified UK incidents.

railway_police.notes: The prerequisite railway_police value is the countable Railway Police mission-generation requirement.

railway_fire.notes: The prerequisite railway_fire value is the countable Railway fire response mission-generation requirement.

tow_trucks.notes: The official tow_trucks prerequisite is the countable Recovery Centre mission-generation requirement.

tow_trucks_large.notes: The official tow_trucks_large prerequisite is the countable HGV Recovery Extension mission-generation requirement.

water_rescue_2.notes: The official water_rescue_2 prerequisite is the countable Coastguard Rescue Station mission-generation requirement.

coastal_rescue_count.notes: The official coastal_rescue_count prerequisite is the countable Lifeboat Station mission-generation requirement. It remains distinct from water_rescue_2, which represents Coastguard Rescue Stations.

coastal_helicopter_count.notes: Required Coastguard Rescue Helicopter Hangar count.

water_damage_pump_count.notes: Required Water Damage Pump Extension count.

technical_aid.notes: Required Search and Rescue HQ count.

bomb_disposal_diver.notes: Required Bomb Disposal Marine Unit Extension count.

max_police_stations.notes: This is an upper generation bound, not a minimum station precondition.
